description:
Minneapolis Climate History and Outlook: This video explains the changing climate of Minneapolis, Minnesota, based on instrumental observations and climate model projections. It covers temperature and precipitation trends, impacts on urban life, and the city's adaptation efforts. Source: Minnesota Department of Natural Resources, NOAA, and Metropolitan Council.
